newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MRCB raises stake in NSTP, TV3.
newsitem.headline: MRCB raises stake in NSTP, TV3.

text.p: Malaysian Resources Corp Bhd (MRCB) has increased its stakes in publishing group, the New Straits Times Press (Malaysia) Bhd (NSTP) and private television operator, Sistem Televisyen Malaysia Bhd (TV3).
In a statement released late on Friday, MRCB said it had purchased an additional 125,000 NSTP shares on the open market at prices ranging from 14.20 to 14.70 ringgit per share.
It also acquired an additional 539,000 TV3 shares at between 5.10 and 5.45 ringgit a share.
Following the purchases, MRCB now holds a 45.47 percent stake in NSTP and 45.35 percent of TV3, the statement said.
On Friday, NSTP shares closed at 14.20 ringgit and TV3 at 5.40 ringgit.
